message: I have a friend who always thinks the sky is falling at the first sign of a storm, and while I love her enthusiasm for preparedness, I prefer to stay calm and collected. When it comes to power outages, knowing what to do can make all the difference. I recently stumbled upon a great resource that offers practical tips for handling blackouts. It’s a handy reminder that a little planning can keep us cozy and comfortable during those unexpected moments. How do you stay prepared for a power outage?
